verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents offline evaluation: you run your application against curated datasets as experiments to compare versions and catch regressions, with configurable evaluators. That is the core of regression evals. The evidence never mentions running these in a CI pipeline or using results to pass/fail a build or gate a deployment. missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or pytest/vitest runners), pass/fail thresholds that gate deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions.
Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment.
Add real traces to a dataset so a failure you saw once becomes a test you run every time.
